{{Quote|It is&hellip;my gift. An Embassy is spawned with that gift. A Render is spawned with savage claws and jaws. A Tapper has spikes that cut stone.|Embassy-Who-Climbs to Stavin Thaal|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''Render''' was a fictional role created by [[Turman Durra]], the [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Actor/Legends|actor]] from the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]], as part of his [[Embass suit|disguise]] as "Embassy-Who-Climbs", an unidentified creature recently awakened from the depths of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]]'s [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]. Durra created the role to add background to his character when asked by [[Stavin Thaal]], the Galactic Alliance [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] he was meeting and the target of the Wraiths' [[Mission to Kuratooine|mission]] to expose his corrupt activities. 

According to Durra, Renders were born with savage claws and jaws, while an Embasses like himself were gifted with the ability to learn languages.<ref name="MK" />
